lines: Election Day so far: registered Republicans 50.7% of voters, Democrats 25.8%, others 23.5%.
Florida's whole Election Day was 50.4% Republicans, 26.7% Democrats and 22.9% others in 2022, and 42.2%, 27.2% and 30.6% in 2024.
So far today looks like 2022's Election Day.

Every vote so far, mail, early and today: Republicans 42.1%, Democrats 35.6%. 2022 final: 45.5% and 33.4%. 2024 final: 42.7% and 31.7%. Today's votes are still coming in, so this mix moves toward the Election Day mix until the polls close.
Party is registration, not the vote. Who votes on the day also depends on how many voted early or by mail.
